# watchpoint_udp_monitor (Resource)

A UDP monitor: sends one datagram and optionally asserts on the reply; an ICMP port-unreachable fails the check. Requires the `udp_monitors` feature. Hosted locations only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Send a raw DNS query for example.com (type A) and expect a reply.
resource "watchpoint_udp_monitor" "resolver" {
  name           = "Internal resolver"
  host           = "ns1.example.com"
  port           = 53
  payload        = "abcd01000001000000000000076578616d706c6503636f6d0000010001"
  payload_is_hex = true
  expect_regex   = ".+"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Target host name or IP.
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name; shown across the UI and alerts.

### Optional

- `alert_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls notification channels and routing.
- `check_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between checks. Plans cap the minimum.
- `expect_contains` (String) Substring the reply must contain. With no expectation a silent server passes, since UDP has no handshake to fail.
- `expect_regex` (String) Regular expression the reply must match.
- `group_id` (String) Monitor group this monitor belongs to.
- `location_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls which regions run the check. Hosted regions only: private locations refuse this monitor type.
- `payload` (String) Datagram to send (4096 characters max). Text, or hex when `payload_is_hex` is set.
- `payload_is_hex` (Boolean) Treat `payload` as hex bytes. Defaults to `false`.
- `port` (Number) UDP port. Defaults to `53`.
- `sla_profile_id` (String) SLA profile attached to this monitor. Requires the SLA monitoring feature. When omitted the monitor keeps whatever it has, which on create is the tenant's default SLA profile if one is set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Free-form tags surfaced in filters and SGL queries. Unordered.
- `threshold_profile_id` (String) Profile that controls consecutive-failure logic.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Check timeout in seconds.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Monitor ID.
- `last_check_status` (String) Status of the last check (`Success`, `Warning`, `Critical`, ...), or null.
- `status` (String) Current monitor status (e.g. `Active`, `Paused`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_udp_monitor.resolver mon_udp_001
```
